progress.command:
ROOT=$(cat /tmp/pit-raw-root); S=$ROOT/tmux.sock
cap() { tmux -S $S capture-pane -p -t raw | sed -e 's/[[:space:]]*$//' | grep -v '^$' | grep -v 'Warning\|^ *raw-call\|Extensions\|Press ctrl\|Pi can explain\|▀\|█'; echo =====; }
tmux -S $S send-keys -t raw C-o; sleep 1.5; cap
tmux -S $S send-keys -t raw "run fixture" Enter; sleep 4
tmux -S $S send-keys -t raw "run invalid fixture" Enter; sleep 4; cap
tmux -S $S send-keys -t raw C-o; sleep 1.5; cap
tmux -S $S kill-server; rm -rf $ROOT
